theorems.statement: ∀ (m q : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) q) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (q + 1)), (∀ (η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (q + 1)) (φ : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) q), (∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ (x : Eucl m) (v : Fin q → Eucl m), (φ s : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) q) x v = (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (q + 1)) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) → Z η = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, X (φ s)) → ∀ (η η' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (q + 1)) (N : Set (Eucl (m + 1))), IsOpen N → {y : Eucl (m + 1) | EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ y 0 ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ X.support} ⊆ N → (∀ y ∈ N, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (q + 1)) y = (η' : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (q + 1)) y) → Z η = Z η'
